section: Sticky ATC — mobile bar no longer cropped at bottom/right
commit_message: fix(pdp): float mobile sticky ATC as inset pill so edges are never cropped
acceptance_criteria: On mobile, the sticky ATC bar is fully visible with margin on left, right, and bottom — no edge cropping under system nav bars or in in-app browsers
The bar renders as a rounded floating pill with the full add-to-cart button visible
